async def act(page):
    # Click the target branch selector button (likely 'primer/design') to open dropdown
    target_branch_button = page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("button", name="primer/design")
    await target_branch_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to appear

    bump_doctocat_option = page.get_by_role("listitem", name="bump-doctocat", exact=False)

    compare_button = page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("button", name="Compare branches and continue")
    await compare_button.click()
